summary: Legend Biotech Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on offering of 7,700,000 ADSs (each representing two ordinary shares) at a public price of $29.35 per ADS, for total gross proceeds of approximately $226 million. The underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 1,155,000 ADSs. The offering is underwritten by Morgan Stanley, Jefferies, Citigroup, and Deutsche Bank Securities. Settlement is expected on T+2, June 23, 2026. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The filing does not involve a change of control, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate event.
